title: After Hours
summary: Start: enter After Hours. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Night Broker. Do: come within 320 meters of the Night Broker. The broker slides alongside and keeps the amber window after the navy goes home. An ambush holds the buoy until 520 meters. A kite keeps the flank. Finish: after the broker is met, come inside Night Market's shell. The navy writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
